title: Runs agree on short oracle queries
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine, let $O$ and $O'$ be oracle languages, and let $x$ be an input word. Suppose that for every word $z$ with $|z|<t$, membership in $O$ and $O'$ agrees. Then the configurations reached after $t$ steps from the initial configuration on $x$, using $O$ and $O'$ respectively, are equal.
hypotheses_covered: Membership in O and O' agrees for every word of length less than t
